entries.title: Job 33:1
segments: ¶Wherefore, Job, I pray thee, hear my speeches, and hearken to all my words.

entries.title: Job 33:2
segments: Behold, now I have opened my mouth, my tongue hath spoken in my mouth. {in my mouth: Heb. in my palate}

words.text: . {in my mouth: Heb. in my palate}

entries.title: Job 33:3
segments: My words [shall be of] the uprightness of my heart: and my lips shall utter knowledge clearly.

entries.title: Job 33:4
segments: The Spirit of God hath made me, and the breath of the Almighty hath given me life.

entries.title: Job 33:5
segments: If thou canst answer me, set [thy words] in order before me, stand up.

entries.title: Job 33:6
segments: Behold, I [am] according to thy wish in God's stead: I also am formed out of the clay. {wish: Heb. mouth} {formed: Heb. cut}

words.text: Behold, I [am] according to thy wish

entries.title: Job 33:7
segments: Behold, my terror shall not make thee afraid, neither shall my hand be heavy upon thee.

entries.title: Job 33:8
segments: ¶Surely thou hast spoken in mine hearing, and I have heard the voice of [thy] words, [saying], {hearing: Heb. ears}

entries.title: Job 33:9
segments: I am clean without transgression, I [am] innocent; neither [is there] iniquity in me.

entries.title: Job 33:10
segments: Behold, he findeth occasions against me, he counteth me for his enemy,

entries.title: Job 33:11
segments: He putteth my feet in the stocks, he marketh all my paths.

entries.title: Job 33:12
segments: Behold, [in] this thou art not just: I will answer thee, that God is greater than man.

words.text: Behold, [in] this thou art not just

entries.title: Job 33:13
segments: Why dost thou strive against him? for he giveth not account of any of his matters. {he giveth...: Heb. he answereth not}

words.text: against him? for he giveth not account

entries.title: Job 33:14
segments: ¶For God speaketh once, yea twice, [yet man] perceiveth it not.

entries.title: Job 33:15
segments: In a dream, in a vision of the night, when deep sleep falleth upon men, in slumberings upon the bed;

entries.title: Job 33:16
segments: Then he openeth the ears of men, and sealeth their instruction, {he...: Heb. he revealeth, or, uncovereth}

entries.title: Job 33:17
segments: That he may withdraw man [from his] purpose, and hide pride from man. {purpose: Heb. work}

entries.title: Job 33:18
segments: He keepeth back his soul from the pit, and his life from perishing by the sword. {from perishing: Heb. from passing}

entries.title: Job 33:19
segments: ¶He is chastened also with pain upon his bed, and the multitude of his bones with strong [pain]:

entries.title: Job 33:20
segments: So that his life abhorreth bread, and his soul dainty meat. {dainty...: Heb. meat of desire}

entries.title: Job 33:21
segments: His flesh is consumed away, that it cannot be seen; and his bones [that] were not seen stick out.

entries.title: Job 33:22
segments: Yea, his soul draweth near unto the grave, and his life to the destroyers.

entries.title: Job 33:23
segments: If there be a messenger with him, an interpreter, one among a thousand, to shew unto man his uprightness:

entries.title: Job 33:24
segments: Then he is gracious unto him, and saith, Deliver him from going down to the pit: I have found a ransom. {a ransom: or, an atonement}

entries.title: Job 33:25
segments: His flesh shall be fresher than a child's: he shall return to the days of his youth: {a child's: Heb. childhood}

entries.title: Job 33:26
segments: He shall pray unto God, and he will be favourable unto him: and he shall see his face with joy: for he will render unto man his righteousness.

words.text: unto him: and he shall see

entries.title: Job 33:27
segments: He looketh upon men, and [if any] say, I have sinned, and perverted [that which was] right, and it profited me not; {He...: or, He shall look upon men, and say}

words.text: me not; {He...: or, He shall look upon men, and say}

entries.title: Job 33:28
segments: He will deliver his soul from going into the pit, and his life shall see the light. {He...: or, He hath delivered my soul, etc, and my life}

words.text: . {He...: or, He hath delivered my soul, etc, and my life}

entries.title: Job 33:29
segments: ¶Lo, all these [things] worketh God oftentimes with man, {oftentimes: Heb. twice and thrice}

entries.title: Job 33:30
segments: To bring back his soul from the pit, to be enlightened with the light of the living.

entries.title: Job 33:31
segments: Mark well, O Job, hearken unto me: hold thy peace, and I will speak.

entries.title: Job 33:32
segments: If thou hast any thing to say, answer me: speak, for I desire to justify thee.

entries.title: Job 33:33
segments: If not, hearken unto me: hold thy peace, and I shall teach thee wisdom.
